workload.description: one claude -p turn (Reply with exactly: PONG. Do not use tools.)

caveat: CPU and RSS cover the whole collector process tree (the Rust binary, the eBPF programs it spawns, and the Python ONNX inference server); reaped children are counted through cutime/cstime. Samples are once per second, so a very short-lived child can be missed. Event counts are lines beginning with '{' in the collector log. This baseline is a budget input, not a benchmark: the offline gate leaves a wide margin for CI variance.
